x: Though, Thompson striding to a great win in the 50 Kilos walk; Radford flashing to a bronze medal in the 100 metres; Elliott toying with the world's best over 1500 metres; "wild-man" Cerutty running on to the track; Avril Williams throwing the javelin beyond the Olympic record and into second place,…

…imbs up the horse-rides in the darkness of Tuesday evenings chasing the unseen figures of Robinson, Miller, Shippen and Thompson; out on the dimly lit roads of Wimbledon on Thursdays, gasping behind Linstead, Dabbs, Gebbett & Co. as they did the "seven hills"; sometimes on the "Warren 9" with Bird,…
To go to the head of the field and win the race and to be acclaimed with the names of Whitlock, Baker, Thompson, Pamich, Middleton is something extra.
